#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int h, n;
    std::cin >> h >> n;
    int n_minus_one = n - 1;
    std::string binary_string;
    while (n_minus_one > 0) {
        binary_string = (char)((n_minus_one % 2) + '0') + binary_string;
        n_minus_one /= 2;
    }
    int padding = h - binary_string.length();
    std::string padded_binary(padding, '0');
    padded_binary += binary_string;

    int total_value = 0;
    bool flag_state = true;
    for (int position_index = 0; position_index < h; ++position_index) {
        if (padded_binary[position_index] == (flag_state ? '1' : '0')) {
            total_value += (int)pow(2, h - position_index);
        } else {
            flag_state = !flag_state;
            total_value += 1;
        }
    }
    std::cout << total_value << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
